shared_elements: horizontal register lines separating lines of text
incised/carved surface with repeated small glyph-like units
justification: Both surfaces bear lines of writing arranged in horizontal registers, but the scripts are utterly different in character — A shows thin linear alphabetic letters in three ruled bands occupying only the upper third, with a large elaborate foliate cross with scrolled terminals filling the lower field, while B shows columns of dense, blocky, rounded relief glyph-blocks covering the whole visible surface with no pictorial motif. Apart from the generic fact of inscribed text in rows, there is no shared motif, relationship or layout.
